image_spec.headline: Leftovers keep 3 to 4 days in the fridge. For Thursday's, that's Monday.
image_spec.body: Put them away within 2 hours, in shallow containers. Frozen, they're best within 2 to 6 months.
image_spec.tip: Freeze what you won't eat by Sunday.

posts.caption:
Two days to go, so here's the one you'll want Thursday night.

Leftovers keep 3 to 4 days in the fridge, according to FoodSafety.gov. If the feast is Thursday, Monday is the cutoff for that turkey.

One habit makes it easy. Get everything put away within 2 hours, in small shallow containers so it cools fast. Anything you won't eat by Sunday goes in the freezer, where it's best within 2 to 6 months. 🧊

Which leftover are you most excited about? Tell us below.

image_spec.headline: Make room for Thursday. Start with what's about to turn.
image_spec.body: Pantry gives you a heads-up 48 hours before food goes bad, so it gets eaten before the turkey moves in.

posts.caption:
Tonight or tomorrow, someone in your house is going to open the fridge and say there's no room for the turkey.

They're right. Behind the milk there's half a jar of salsa, three yogurts and a bag of spinach that's had a rough week.

Eat the stuff that's close to turning first. Tonight can be a clean-out dinner, and nobody has to call it that.

That's what we're building Pantry for. StashSmart gives you a heads-up 48 hours before something goes bad, so you know what to use first. Coming soon to iPhone. 🥛
